title: Eaton ELCSoft
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER INPUT VALIDATION CWE-20 There are multiple cases where specially crafted files could cause a buffer overflow which, in turn, may allow remote execution of arbitrary code. CVE-2018-7511 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.3 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ). RESEARCHER Ariele Caltabiano (kimiya) and axt working with Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative reported the vulnerability to NCCIC.
